description: Muse Music v1.0.5 brings real-time Muse Cloud Sync for Liked Songs and Custom Playlists, automatic web backup restoration, and Nothing OS 5.0 sync indicator.

changelog.title: Muse Cloud Sync & Web Backup
items: Real-time bidirectional synchronization for Liked Songs between Muse Web and APK
Full Custom Playlist sync including playlist metadata and tracks
Automatic cloud backup reconciliation: existing web likes and playlists are automatically restored upon sign-in
Instant local and cloud updates with loop prevention and offline database persistence
Dedicated Nothing OS 5.0 Muse Cloud Sync status tile and manual 'Sync Now' action in Account Settings

changelog.title: Performance & Stability
items: Optimized Firestore snapshot listeners with non-blocking Kotlin coroutines
Eliminated race conditions during playlist track reconciliation
Enhanced session persistence and token lifecycle handling across app launches
